system.description:
Extended Critical Range (Pistols) Talent created by Wikia user LilLiteralist.

When you are using a Pistol, you extend the weapon's critical range by 1 (for example, 19-20 instead of 20). However, anything other than a Natural 20 is not considered an automatic hit; if you roll anything other than a Natural 20 and still miss the target, you do not score a Critical Hit.

prerequisite.text: Base Attack Bonus 10, and Weapon Proficiency (Pistols)
